title: MZ Looking for a plugin that causes After image effect for pictures.

posts.author: Bladeboy05
posts.body: As the title suggests, I'm looking for a plugin that allow you to put after image effect on pictures. Say if I have a picture displayed on the map it will cause an after effect to it as the picture moves around on the map.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
QJ bullet can do it for the player or events
QJ-MapProjectileMZ by qiujiu
The projectile plugin for rpg maker mz.
qiujiu.itch.io

posts.author: Bladeboy05
posts.body: I really  appreciate your response, I'm aware of this Plugin, however it only works on Events and Characters. I have a float orb picture that moves around on my map. However I need this effect for pictures.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MZ Support to JS Plugin Requests.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: But you can also make the orb an event?

posts.author: Bladeboy05
posts.body: Well the orb that I drew is a giant orb, it takes up the space of several tiles. It's supposed to be a giant orb. It seems like there's no script that is made that can do what I'm asking for. I know that there several Picture effects plugins out there, but none of them do what I'm looking for.
